description: 16-DI PNP sink input ioThinx 45MR slot module. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address (slot base assigned dynamically by ioThinx 4510 chassis). Only ch0-3 support event counter mode; ch4-15 are DI-only. FC01: diCounterStatus ch0-3 (0=Pause 1=Run), diCounterOverflowFlagClear ch0-3 (W=1 to clear). FC02: diStatus ch0-15, diMode ch0-15 (0=DI 1=Counter), diCounterOverflowFlag ch0-3. FC03: diCounterValue ch0-3 u64 4-words/ch (rel 0-15), diCounterStatusAll bitmask (rel 16), diCounterOverflowFlagClearAll (rel 17). FC04: diStatusAll (1 WORD), diCounterOverflowFlagAll (1 WORD), diModeAll (1 WORD).
